## Actuaries in Vietnam: a profession on the rise

<!-- Optional slide for Vietnamese prospective students, switched by
     `show.vietnam` in _quarto.yml (or --profile vietnam). Sources: Odierno,
     Kau and Nguyen, "The Growing Strength of Actuaries in Vietnam", The Actuary
     (Society of Actuaries), January 2021; Vietnam Investment Review for the
     life insurance coverage figures (link in the notes). Check the figures and
     regulations are current before each session. -->

::: {.cards .cards-jobs}
::: {.card .fragment}
**Young and growing fast**

Life insurance in Vietnam is only about 20 years old. About 12% of people have life insurance, compared with 50–80% in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand.
:::
::: {.card .fragment}
**Required by law**

As in many countries, every insurer in Vietnam must have a qualified actuary to set prices, calculate reserves and keep the company solvent.
:::
::: {.card .fragment}
**More actuaries needed**

An emerging market with plenty of room to grow, and an actuarial community that is still maturing.
:::
:::

::: {.keyphrase .fragment .vn-close}
Vietnam's top actuarial roles need an international fellowship, such as the SOA's. ANU is an SOA Centre of Actuarial Excellence, so students can earn credit towards SOA exams while they study.
:::

[Sources: H. S. Odierno, S. H. Kau and N. Nguyen, "The Growing Strength of Actuaries in Vietnam", *The Actuary* (Society of Actuaries), January 2021; *Vietnam Investment Review* (vir.com.vn).]{.source-line}

::: {.notes}
About 1 min, for Vietnamese students or schools. Source for card 1: https://vir.com.vn/vietnams-life-insurance-sector-eyes-growth-amid-widening-protection-gap-160447.html. Card 3: 220+ candidates sat SOA exams in Vietnam in 2019; the degrees are at the National Economics University (Hanoi) and the University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH). The 2016 rule is Decree 76: the appointed actuary of a life insurer must be a fellow of an international body such as the SOA, with 10 years in life and health insurance or 5 years after qualifying, and must live in Vietnam. Non-life insurers need at least an associate. The article is from 2021, so the numbers will have grown since; check the current rules before quoting them as up to date.
:::
